description: Header file defining the AlpsDecoder class for parsing HTTP/2 frames in the ALPS TLS extension, including nested classes for settings and ACCEPT_CH frame parsing, with enums for error codes and methods for decoding and retrieving parsed data.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding HTTP/2 frames in the ALPS TLS extension, managing settings and ACCEPT_CH frame parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder::SettingsParser
classes.description: Nested class implementing a visitor for parsing HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder::AcceptChParser
classes.description: Nested class implementing a visitor for parsing ACCEPT_CH frames.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a span of data representing ALPS extension data, returning an error code.

methods.name: settings_frame_count
methods.description: Returns the number of SETTINGS frames received.

methods.name: GetSettings
methods.description: Returns the parsed HTTP/2 setting parameters.

methods.name: GetAcceptCh
methods.description: Returns the parsed Accept-CH origin-value pairs.
